|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family]] (its only version). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. |combos=* Start the game with [[The Rise Of Skywalker]] to pull [[The Force Is Strong In My Family]] to take full advantage of Ahsoka's game text.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Ahsoka%2C%20Friend%20Of%20The%20Family Scomp: Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family]; card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * Protects against DVDLOTS, [[Force Lightning]], [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet]], [[Physical Choke]], [[Set For Stun]], [[Trample]]
* Subtract 1 from your own destiny draw for [[I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This]], [[Sense]], or [[Alter]].
|rulings=* Does not need to be at the same location to subtract 1 from a non-weapon destiny draw.<ref name="scomp" />
* However, if Ahsoka does happen to be at the location and is excluded during a battle, then she is inactive, and cannot subtract.
